thread:
Luis M.: Heads-up: we need cross-team alignment for the predictive prefetch MVP. pilots expect tighter medians. can owners list hard blockers + acceptable gating rules by EOD Thu?
Nina C.: runtime: big unknown is warmup stability under multi-turn chats. we need a seeding strategy that doesn't overfetch. proposing "trace-seed + top-prefix" hybrid.
Omar H.: infra: autoscaler cold-start is the main blocker. options: reserved warm pool or fast-warm API. reserved pool cost ~10% extra. fast-warm requires a small API change.
Sofia T.: security/compliance: prefetch touches cached model state; must use separate KMS keys and immutable audit records for prefetch actions. also need threat model for replayed prefetches.
Ravi P.: eng-sre: monitoring & rollback notes: if p95 latency climbs >30% or error_rate increases >0.5% during canary, instant rollback. need a synthetic load that mimics pilot patterns.
Luis M.: acceptance targets I'm proposing: median gen <=180ms, p90 <=420ms on pilot tenants; prefetch should seed >=75% of hot prefixes during pilot window; cost uplift <=18%.
Nina C.: implementation plan: two sprints for hybrid seeding + CRC per cache entry. CRC adds ~0.6ms but catches corruption. need infra prewarm endpoint to hit target dates.
Omar H.: timeline: can deliver prewarm API in 5 working days if we bump one infra backlog item. otherwise reserved pool available immediately. will share cost breakdown.
Sofia T.: KMS guidance: separate key per-tenant for prefetch metadata + write-only audit stream to eventstore. I'll share a short policy template in #eng-security. also need key-rotation guidance tied to cache TTLs.
Ravi P.: canary schedule (draft):
```
- canary: 5% traffic for 30m
- ramp to 25% for 1h if health ok
- ramp to 60% for 2h
- full deploy after 6h stable
Health checks: end_to_end_p50/p95, kv_crc_failures, prefetch_success_rate
Rollback triggers: p95 +30% OR kv_crc_failures >0.2% OR prefetch_success_rate <90%
```
Luis M.: risks to call out: runaway prefetching -> cost spike, synthetic test mismatch with real customer behavior, KMS rotation tearing cached entries. add canary + cost cap alarms.
Nina C.: perf tests: I'll run batch sims and real-request replays. need sample prompt sets from pilots.
Omar H.: cost cap: we can set budget alerts and an automatic throttle if infra spend >projected_pilot_cost * 1.25. ops owns the circuit-breaker.
Sofia T.: also recommend documenting failure mode: prefetch fails -> fall back to cold-exec path and log request id with reason. must be visible in audit.
Ravi P.: runbook items I'll own: toggle flag, throttle to 0, rollback steps, diagnostic commands, and a postmortem checklist. will post draft in #eng-oncall by EOD Wed.
Luis M.: action items (owners): Nina: seed algorithm + perf target; Omar: prewarm API vs reserved cost + schedule; Sofia: KMS policy + audit template; Ravi: monitoring + runbook + synthetic job. deadline: EOD Thu.
